existing_mapping.evidence: The ParkingLot class includes attributes for a unique identifier, name, address, and city.
ParkingLot class includes an attribute for the number of available spaces.
There is an association where each Vehicle is linked to exactly one Client.
The ParkingSession class contains attributes for start time and references to vehicle details.
ParkingSpace class includes an attribute for size, indicating accommodation for vehicle sizes.
The Conveyor class specifies the maximum vehicle weight it can handle.
ParkingSession and Conveyor are associated but not stored past the end of the session.
Each ParkingLot can have multiple pricing lists detailing various prices such as for hourly and full-day.
ClubMembership involves a discount attribute for all parking sessions.
ClubMembership is linked with ParkingSession to provide a free session for members during the registration month.
The ReportGenerator class can produce an annual summary report covering all ParkWise income.
The report includes a list of parking lots, payments made per lot, and count of vehicles with 'other' color.
Reports are ordered by city in descending order and total amount in ascending order as supported by ReportGenerator.
Reports can be generated in both PDF and XML by functions in ReportService interface.
ReportService generates monthly overview reports for club members' growth.
The club growth report includes monthly new club members and cumulative totals with growth statistics.
Monthly growth reports are ordered in ascending order by month.
